text:
sara: quick ping — PR #7894 updates KV cache eviction heuristics; blocking the dedicated rollout. CI is failing on the e2e kv-cache test. can someone take a look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7894

ci-bot: build #7894 — FAILURE on job `kv-cache-integration`
```
kv-cache-integration: ERROR: test_kv_eviction_timeout (tests.integration.test_kv)
TimeoutError: Test exceeded 120s waiting for backend response
   at tests/integration/test_kv.py:87
Full output: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/7894/log
```

jordan: I'll take a look in ~15m. is this blocking the deploy?

sara: yes, we planned to promote the dedicated pool with these changes today. blocked until green.

lee: can you confirm if the eviction TTL changed in this PR or just the heuristics? TTL changes can make ordering flakier.

anita: if it's a transient harness timeout, a rerun might pass. can someone queue a rerun while jordan looks?

eng-oncall: queued rerun: `/ci rerun 7894 --job kv-cache-integration` — started.

ci-bot: rerun #7894 (attempt 2) — started tests for `kv-cache-integration`.

ci-bot: rerun #7894 — PASSED all tests for `kv-cache-integration`.

jordan: looks like a transient timeout in the test harness — the backend had a slow startup on the original run. not seeing a deterministic failure locally.

lee: cool. still probably worth hardening the test a bit (increase wait/retry) since eviction relies on timers. a follow-up test tweak would be good.

sara: i'll open a tiny follow-up PR to add a retry and a slightly higher timeout in that test. merging #7894 now that CI is green. thanks all :tada:

anita: thanks — nice unblock.

lee: FWIW, i'll monitor kv miss/hit metrics for the next hour after deploy. ping if anything odd.

sara: ack, thanks everyone!
